num_customers: <int> Number of customers to be served by the truck-drone team.
num_nodes: <int> Total number of locations including the depot and all customers.
alpha: <int> Drone speed multiplier relative to the truck, used to scale Euclidean distances for drone travel times.

nodes.id: <int> Unique identifier for this location, where 0 is the depot and 1 through num_customers are customers.
nodes.label: <str> Human-readable name for this location.
nodes.x: <int> Horizontal coordinate of this location on the grid.
nodes.y: <int> Vertical coordinate of this location on the grid.

truck_travel_times: <list[list[int]], shape [num_nodes][num_nodes]> Travel time for the truck between each pair of locations using the Manhattan distance metric.
drone_travel_times: <list[list[int]], shape [num_nodes][num_nodes]> Travel time for the drone between each pair of locations using the Euclidean distance scaled by the drone speed factor.
